label: Getting there
value: Lalko village is the first settlement on the way; a four-wheel drive vehicle is needed from there
quote: It is the first settlement met on the way to Gabin Jabba, from where it can be accessed through a four-wheel drive vehicle.

label: Distance
quote: is located approximately 65 km from Mingora on Matta Sakhra road

label: Winter
value: Heavy snowfall in winter, Lalko Valley
quote: receives heavy snowfall in winter season

label: Lake trail
value: A base camp for a trail to the alpine glacial lakes of Daral and Saidgai
quote: It also hosts a base camp of a trail that leads to an alpine glacial lakes of Daral and Saidgai.

label: What to see
value: Green meadows, thick forests, snow-clad mountains, mineral springs
quote: It is an area in Swat Valley with green meadows, thick forests, snow-clad mountains, mineral springs and high peaks.

label: Birds
quote: The entire track from the base to the top is flooded with songs of several species of birds.
